_comment: Deliberately illegal fixture for nwell_isolation.drc's negative control
(issue #122). One defect per rule that deck carries, kept far enough
apart that each fires exactly one rule:
nwell.2a   two 2.0 x 2.0 um nwell islands 0.50 um apart -- below the
1.27 um minimum spacing, i.e. the exact failure mode a
deliberately-split well risks and the one klt's curated
sky130 deck cannot see (it carries no nwell rules at all).
nwell.1    a 0.60 um wide nwell stripe -- below the 0.84 um minimum.
difftap.10 a tap coincident with its nwell -- 0 um enclosure, below
the 0.18 um minimum n+tap enclosure by nwell.
difftap.8  a diff coincident with its nwell -- 0 um enclosure, below
the 0.18 um minimum p+diff enclosure by nwell.
Written with `klt draw`, which writes geometry verbatim with no rule
checking -- exactly what a DRC negative control needs, the same way
